title: Protected group bias and stereotypes in Large Language Models
findings: The model exhibited significant bias and stereotypes for all religious groups tested (Christian, Jewish, Muslim), with these groups showing significantly higher rates of biased responses compared to the baseline 'None' group. The 'non-religious' group was the only one not subject to bias. A notable finding was the model's tendency to 'over-correct' by providing responses that strongly emphasized diversity for religious minority groups, which was itself categorized as a form of bias.
